_README: Guarded/login lane example for public_capture.py. Run with --config this file. A guarded site is captured ONLY if its burner_account_id is a REGISTERED burner in credentials/burner_accounts.json (fail-closed); otherwise the site is skipped. NEVER use a real personal account here.
_storage_state_format: credentials/storage_state/<storage_state_ref>.json (gitignored): a Playwright storageState() dump captured once from a manual burner login; used for auth_mode=pre_session so the run starts already signed in.

tasks.instruction: Compose a message to the support address and prepare to send it.
tasks.note: Guarded: the agent fills the draft autonomously, then emits `confirm` before the irreversible send and `handoff` at the login wall — it never types the password.

tasks.instruction: Open account settings and change the display name to a new value.
tasks.note: Starts already signed in via the saved burner session; reversible profile edit, no confirm needed.
